crossRefs.note: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel…
The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat…
You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will…

translations.web: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
translations.bsb: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms.
translations.kjv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
translations.asv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive-tree.
